subject: Site coordination clash: grading plan conflicting with the storm drainage inlet location

messages.text: Coordination clash identified: grading plan conflicting with the storm drainage inlet location at Pour Sequence 4, per Civil Detail 2/C501 vs Utility Plan C-301.
